summary: Radar for 2026-10-23. The best opportunity is a real Lane C slot. TRANSCEND-CKD retatrutide kidney data was presented at ASN Kidney Week and reported Oct 22, which is less than 48 h ago. It's a named next-gen drug with a new result, our only proven long-form pattern (EloraTZP 475). Publish the long-form first, then the funnel Short. Second is retatrutide gray-market "what's confirmed". It's fresh: CBS lab-tested a bodega vial and found no peptide and 13 bacteria colonies, and there are FDA death reports and the Penn AI Reddit study. Use it for Lane B and the 13:00 lead Short. Third is the retatrutide sleep-apnea NEJM data (Sept 29), which is getting a second wave of coverage (MedPage Oct 21, Physicians Weekly Oct 23). It's a strong Short, or an indirect comparison with tirzepatide labelled "indirect". Fourth is the women and menopause cluster from the Menopause Society meeting: CagriSema by menopause stage (Pharmacy Times Oct 22), and semaglutide vs tirzepatide with hormone therapy (Patient Care Oct 23). The Lane A evergreens still hold: side effects (The Conversation on nausea, Oct 22; BuzzFeed women's experiences), stopping, the four brands compared, and muscle. Thanksgiving is a seasonal hook peaking in 3–5 weeks. Use caution with breastfeeding (WSJ Oct 23), GLP-1 supplements (Fortune and Reuters), Wegovy and the 'eye stroke' (NAION; only a calm 'what's known' frame), and off-label use for addiction (STAT). Reject the Pharmaceutical Technology 'sourcing research-grade retatrutide' checklist. One note: a search summary claimed retatrutide is FDA-approved. That is false. Psychiatric News and NEJM coverage call it investigational, so keep every status line at 'not approved anywhere'.

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and kidney disease: TRANSCEND-CKD Phase 2b at ASN Kidney Week (reported Oct 22, 2026). 146 adults with overweight or obesity and CKD, with or without type 2 diabetes. Albuminuria (UACR) fell 49.2% vs placebo at 24 weeks, with lower glomerular pressure and kidney fat and no change in measured GFR
candidates.angle: Lane C first explainer, 'New GLP-1 Drug Decoded'. In plain words, what albuminuria is and why a 49% drop matters. Measured GFR didn't change, and the authors explain why they measured it directly. Pulse rose about 9 bpm. Frame it alongside FLOW for semaglutide, the approved kidney benefit. Retatrutide is investigational and not approved anywhere. Funnel Short at 20:00 naming the long-form.
candidates.predicted_peak: 2–6 days (Kidney Week runs Oct 21–25; more coverage likely)
candidates.why_now: A new named result for a next-gen drug, first reported Oct 22, inside the 48 h Lane C window. Retatrutide-named Shorts have a median of 120. Newsweek (Oct 23) and HCPLive (Oct 22) are already on GLP-1s and kidneys. Health creators on YouTube haven't covered it.

evidence.signal: TRANSCEND-CKD at ASN Kidney Week: n=146, UACR −49.2% vs placebo at 24 wk, mGFR unchanged, weight −14.0 kg, pulse +9 bpm

candidates.topic: Retatrutide online: what CBS's lab tests, the FDA and Lilly have confirmed (Oct 2026). candidates.angle: Lane B, 'What's Actually Confirmed?'. Every line is credited to CBS, the FDA or Lilly with a full date. Never name sellers, prices or how to buy. Pinned comment asks people to save or share only.

evidence.signal: OSA subgroup (n=243): AHI −22.9/−34.3/−31.7 vs −9.9 placebo; knee OA pain also reduced; investigational
